set.body:
Outcome: a committed prospective protocol can distinguish a useful mapper improvement from conditional-oracle gains, tuning leakage and changes in coverage. This is a bounded child of G3, not a replacement for its broader human-study acceptance or the separate Phase1a LLM comparison.

Reuse: tools/recall-study/sealed_split.py, exposure/read-count ledgers, organization_recovery.py, organization_challenge.py, organization_diagnosis.py, entity_hypotheses.py and the instrument repair bd-01M2TAAQNS7RCCBBM8WFFZF6ZZ. Inspect existing read histories first; the previously opened organization holdout and reused development examples are not a fresh test set.

Acceptance before new gold/output reads:
1. Name the population, task, independent sampling unit, eligible material, development versus untouched evaluation allocation and training-exposure limitations. Source/stimulus and participant dependence determine the split; a file split alone does not establish independence. Pin eligibility and exposure manifests without opening sealed labels.
2. Specify the frozen pipeline/model/tokenizer/configuration and a small comparison set: lexical baseline, current local neural reference and declared reconstruction using matched inputs. An oracle-identity arm may diagnose headroom only. Do not launch a broad model search or turn conditional identity knowledge into achieved automatic accuracy.
3. Predeclare one primary contrast/estimand, participant- or stimulus-level uncertainty as appropriate, sample size/precision rationale, secondary metrics and multiplicity handling. Name numerical success, futility and promotion thresholds before evaluation; do not invent favourable thresholds after reading outcomes.
4. Preserve all eligible failures, abstentions and unresolved cases. Separate candidate recall, event localization, identity selection, specificity, emitted-decision risk/coverage and organization error; only assess probability calibration for a declared measure on separately eligible calibration/evaluation data. Agreement is a reference comparison, not an automatic truth/ceiling.
5. At fixed true organization, vary name ambiguity, repeated identities/events, omissions, paraphrase, transcription quality, reversal/revisit and missing observations. Declare how spurious group differences and transition recovery will be judged, with no bridging across unavailable rows. The design must distinguish event discrimination from entity repair.
6. A checked launch refuses changed hashes, overlapping or previously exposed evaluation units, unregistered comparisons and premature sealed reads. Independent scientific review approves the estimand, split, denominator and stopping rules before execution. Preserve existing Friends/Memento single-opening restrictions; this task does not authorize opening them.

Next action: audit the metadata/exposure ledgers and write the protocol before any new scoring. If fresh eligible material or precision is infeasible, record the attainable exploratory claim and the missing resource instead of labeling reused data held out.

Evidence and completion: keep exact baseline/candidate SHA, input and artifact hashes, literal commands and actual exits, passed/failed/skipped totals, initial adverse evidence, and independent exact-SHA review. Runtime changes use tools/reference-scope.sh in a clean standalone clone, fatal warnings, all affected platforms and the pinned StoryAtlas consumer where consumed; formatting runs last. Documentation/tracker-only changes use a format/integrity check and cold review (T2). One primary writer, one helper and one heavy gate at a time. Claim only the slice and reserve its narrow paths. No percentage-complete or efficacy claim follows from ticket/test counts.
set.title: [reality-check E1] Freeze the identity/event and organization evaluation protocol
